journeys.name: Restrict a course for a provider
journeys.description: Enables administrators to add a course to the restricted apprenticeship list for a specific training provider.

journeys.name: Update Provider Information
journeys.description: Allows updating the provider details, including type, status, restrictions, and available courses.

journeys.name: Manage restricted courses
journeys.description: Allows administrators to manage restricted courses and providers.
